name: cache-meter
description: Shows above the prompt how warm the prompt cache is, what a cache miss would cost to rewrite, context fill, and the session's API-rate cost

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long a cached prefix lives after its last use. auto assumes 5m until a cache read after more than five idle minutes shows the one-hour cache, then remembers 1h. Pick 5m or 1h to fix it.

warnBeforeExpiry.title: Warn before the cache goes cold
warnBeforeExpiry.description: A toast one minute before expiry while you're idle, with the rewrite cost.
